hero_desc: Self-taught software engineer and systems enthusiast driven by deep curiosity about how things work under the hood. phase2_title: Where I've Worked & What I Built
barber_desc: Led the backend architecture for a multi-tenant barbershop SaaS, establishing engineering standards (OpenAPI-first and observability) and collaborating cross-functionally to ship reliable, compliant features.
lord_desc: Building a custom Minecraft server from scratch using Java and Minestom for packet handling, with ViaVersion for multi-protocol compatibility. Engineered an event-driven microservices ecosystem utilizing Apache Kafka for asynchronous communication, integrated with a backend API written in Go (Fiber) and strictly documented using OpenAPI specifications.
hive_lead_desc: Led the infrastructure migration from AWS to a bare-metal environment (Proxmox, Ceph, and IaC). Defined backend and infrastructure engineering, focusing on distributed systems and high-availability APIs for platforms including Aventrada and Launchpaid.
hive_se_desc: Built scalable microservices, communication channels, and data processing pipelines. Key deliveries include Affiliate (video monitoring processing 30k+ daily videos with ML integration), 1Auth (E2E-encrypted account platform with RBAC), and RobloxMP (secure RMT marketplace with crypto payment gateway built from scratch).
refugio_desc: Engineered core gameplay and server infrastructure for Refúgio RP, a high-concurrency FiveM (GTA V) roleplay server. Built an automated Whitelist system with database integration, in-game administrative/moderation suites, and led extensive resource profiling (reducing resmon consumption to sub-0.02ms per resource and eliminating tick-loop bottlenecks).
futuremc_desc: The origin of my software engineering journey: engineered custom gameplay mechanics and backend systems for FutureMC, a futuristic Minecraft server operating continuously in live production. Developed in Java utilizing object-oriented architectures, custom network packet handling, and asynchronous MySQL relational database persistence for player data and economies.
